architecture: torchvision MobileNetV3 Small, ImageNet V1, four-output classifier
training: CPU, seed42, frozen convolution features, AdamW lr0.0003, batch16, threads4; select best epoch by validation macro F1
dataset_scope: verified-leaf subset only; original unverified/near-match groups quarantined; full official test retained untouched and not certified
conversion: ONNX FP32; QDQ INT8 minmax calibration on first32 train rows per class; no validation/test calibration
selection_gate: Prefer INT8 for storage only if validation macro F1 drop <=.02 and all class recall drops <=.05; otherwise FP32
validation_reference_parity: preprocessing max absolute error <=1e-6, FP32 logit error <=1e-4
unknowns: No reliability claim until evaluated on specified unknowns; blur/multiple-leaf field unknowns not yet verified
epochs: 8 total: real 3-epoch smoke followed by 5 resumed epochs; fixed before any held-out metrics
